Dialogs.Dialog: Mmm... I'd rather not get a tan...
It has to be... the shrimp float ring...
Glass slippers... seem dangerous to me...
Mirror, mirror... whose cake is... the most delicious in the world...？
A house made of sweets... all mine... ehehe.
Let's take your temperature... you'll be just fine, sweetie...
Time for your shot... ehehe, it doesn't hurt, doesn't hurt...
Ehehe... your pulse is fast... what's wrong...？
A have-a-good-day... kick... ah... I got it wrong... tee-hee...
Geez... I can't cook like this... you big baby...
I'll turn you into... a bunny too... ehehe...
I can't wait for tomorrow's date...
Um, handkerchief, tissues, lip balm. And then...
Hurry up and be tomorrow... Just kidding.
What should I wear to make him happy...
Tomorrow... I'm going to be extra clingy▼
If I'm this nervous already... what's going to happen tomorrow...
Tomorrow will be wonderful too, I'm sure... I want to see him soon...
...I didn't act weird yesterday, did I？
Maybe I got too excited yesterday... I'm a little sleepy...
...Maybe he's thinking back on yesterday right now too. Ehehe！
When can we meet next... Just kidding. Ehehe, was I always this impatient？
...He's so unfair. Why is he so wonderful？
At his house, just the two of us... right？ ...It's kind of embarrassing...
...Why does my heart race so much？ Haah...
I wish we could be together forever...
He's good at this kind of problem... I'll ask him next time▼
There are still two weeks... so just a little... no, I can't. ...Right？
Maybe I'll text him. ...I wish he'd text me.
With him, I can't concentrate, but my studying goes well... ehehe, strange.
He looked so cool studying so seriously...
I wish I'd made plans for today too...
Alarm clock... mm, it's set. ...Maybe I'll ask Mama too, just in case...？
I wonder which side of him I'll see tomorrow...
May tomorrow be a wonderful day. Just kidding.
Kisses are so strange... why do they make me so happy...
If I get better at it, will I feel even more floaty...？
If I said I want more... would he think I'm weird...
...Ah. I spaced out again... because he kisses me like that...
I can't say it's never enough, no matter how many times...
Just remembering it makes me like this... what'll happen next time...
Why do I get like that... me...
...I feel like I can still feel it... haah...
I love him. ...So much. I love... him...
My world is being colored only by him... Just kidding.
I want to see him in my dreams too... I wonder if he'll come.
Making me this crazy about him is against the rules！ ...Just kidding.
What do I do. I really might not be able to sleep...
I didn't know I was this greedy... haah...
I want to hear his voice... I wonder if he'll call...
What is he doing right now... I can't focus on anything...
Is it a luxury to love someone so much it makes you anxious？
Before I met him... how did I spend my time...
If I said I'm lonely, he'd worry. But part of me wants him to...
I want to be with him so much more, forever...
Drifting apart...？ That's not it... right...？
I wonder what boys think about...
...Haah. Ah... all I do is sigh...
Could it be... he's gotten tired of me...
I don't want to feel like this... dummy...
I want to stay like this...
My eyelids are heavy... but I have to get up... but I'm sleepy...
...A dream？ A dream that I got up...
Taking a proper break is part of studying too, right？
Going great, going great♪ Bring on the next problem！ ...Just kidding.
Um... apply this formula... and then...
That treatment might be good... I hope he likes my silky hair.
Ah, no... there, of all places... I hope he doesn't notice！
It's not like I'm lonely or anything...
Was walking home alone always this dull...
...He's not here, is he？ Maybe I'll run into him on the way...
Maybe I'll ask him to eat together...
...Mm, I'll invite him next time. I'm sure it'll taste better that way.
He said he was taking the day off, didn't he. ...Haah...
I wonder what's wrong... no, I have to concentrate.
Taking the day off with him... no, I can't...
You're up. Mm, just for a little while is fine. Shall we talk？
If you don't go to sleep soon, it'll affect tomorrow, you know？ Just kidding. Hey, let's say good night？
Good morning. ...Um, you didn't stay up all night, did you？ If you did, no！
Good morning. Let's eat breakfast properly, okay？ ...No, you're eating. Hehe！
Good morning, are you awake？ Breakfast is ready, you know？ Just kidding.
Ah. You can't wake up before I wake you. Just kidding. Good morning▼
It's already noon. What should I have？ Hey, what do you want to eat？ I'll have the same♪
We need to eat a good lunch and get ready for the afternoon. Right？
Wouldn't it be nice if there were a school rule that said, "Always nap after lunch"？ Just kidding.
Good work. Hey, let's take a break. Together.
Tonight's dinner？ I haven't decided yet. Requests are welcome▼
...Tired？ Okay, then let's take it easy？ I'll be right here.
Oh right, you had homework. Mm... I wish we could keep talking...
Ah, sounds like the bath is ready. ...Geez. No thinking weird thoughts, okay？
I'm going to read a book in bed until I fall asleep. Mm, I'll lend it to you next time？
You're still up... are you okay？ Don't push yourself, okay？
Yes, I was asleep... it's fine. I'm awake now, so let's be together just a little？
Hey, let's go to bed？ ...Because it's lonely by myself...
I'm so glad, I was really worried... I wondered if something happened. I'm so happy you came.
You coming every day makes me so happy, and it's fun. ...Thank you for giving me happiness.
I'm sure he'll like something like this, right？
Maybe he doesn't really like this kind of thing...？
With this combination... ah, this might be nice.
I hope he says it's cute...
I wonder if he'll like this color？
If I styled it more boldly... would he be surprised？
How can I put together a cute outfit...
Ah. Isn't this good？ Yes, it's good, right？
Mm, decided. ...But the last one was nice too...？
Oh right, I'll send him a text...
Should I write it more cutely...
It's a text from him, just as I thought.
A text... ehehe, I knew it▼
Getting a text makes me happy...
！ That surprised me... making my heart race even with a text, geez...
Sent. Notice it soon, Mr. Boyfriend. Just kidding.
...Ah, I pressed the wrong button. This one.
Um, what do I need for tomorrow...
Come to think of it, that thing...
I'm sure it was in the living room...
Maybe I'll try a half-body bath.
Huh. ...Oh no. What do I do？ The scale's not broken, is it？
I got carried away and ate so many sweets... I have to be careful.
Ah, I lost some... I wonder why.
Because I eat so much on dates...？
I see. We haven't been eating out as much lately...
Mm, delicious. If I do say so myself. Hehehe！
Good enough to serve anywhere. Just kidding.
It came out well, so I want him to try it too...
...It tastes a little different than usual？ Um, the sugar, maybe？
Ah. Wrong order... mm, it's fine, it's fine. It'll work.
...Is this right？ I feel like it's not...
Phew. This takes... more strength... than I thought... hnn！
I wonder if he'll like the bento...
Add some color... there, yes, pretty. And the taste is perfect too. Hehe！
I hope he says it's delicious.
I'll do my best on a new dish！
...Next time, I'll make him say it's delicious.
I'll do my best next time too▼
So you can wear it like that too... hmm...
It's nice, but it wouldn't suit me...
Ah, lovely. I have to remember this.
So this is what's in style right now. I see...
This one I think I could make. Let's see...
Ah, this looks handy... I'll go check it out next time.
Looks delicious... maybe I'll try it next time.
A home stove can't get this kind of heat...
This might be good... I'll use it as a reference for his bento▼
Phew. I'm full. Thanks for the meal♪
A little more... just a little more...
Mmm... okay. Time to get up.
Phew, a good wake-up. I wonder what's for breakfast.
What is it... someone's eyes？ Hmm...
It feels like someone is watching me...
Hey, want to talk for a bit？
Hey, is now okay？ I want to chat.
▲主人公＊▲. It's chat time with me, you know？ Just kidding.
I want to talk, even just a little. Okay？
Times like this are nice, aren't they？
You know, there's a place I'm curious about. Let's go sometime？
If anything is bothering you, tell me anytime, okay？
Hey, tell me about something fun that happened lately？
If there's a show you liked, tell me？ I'll negotiate with Papa♪
Hey, what kind of dream did you have recently？ Was it fun？
Did you finish your homework？ ...Mm, let's skip it today. Hehe！
I want to eat a cake made with seasonal fruit...
Club practice has gotten a little tough, hasn't it？ I can barely keep up.
Are there any good movies showing right now？ I'm a little curious.
Huh. ...Yes, I was looking, you know？ Because... no, I won't tell.
Don't you always end up checking horoscopes？ I read the newspaper's.
Hey, do you know a lot about games？ If you have something, I'd like to try it.
If we went on a trip, where would be good... Research. Hehe！
Are you okay on time？ I'm fine.
Hey. ...Can't you hear me？ I see...
Are you busy？ Then I'll talk later, okay？
...Is something wrong？ Should I come back later？
If you want to talk, just call me anytime, okay？
Hmm？ You're done already？ ...Just kidding. Later.
Thank you for the fun time. See you？
Forever... isn't possible, is it... See you.
Hey, you've been in really good shape lately, haven't you？
I knew it. I see right through you▼
I see... I still have a long way to go...
Hey, are you doing well lately？
Hehe, I was right. I'm doing well too... Just kidding♪
Mm... it doesn't really seem that way, though.
Hey, you haven't been feeling bad lately, have you？
I see... they say illness starts in the mind, so let's stay positive？
Hey, have you been feeling down lately？ I had a feeling...
...Then take some of my energy？ Anytime, as much as you want. Okay？
Good. If it gets to be too much, take a break, okay？
Hey, don't do anything too reckless today？ I'm worried...
I went jogging. Early mornings feel so nice, you know？
For breakfast this morning, salted salmon, miso soup, pickles, natto... is that too much？
Today I took a walk with Mama. Papa stayed home.
Even on days off, I wake up early... is that a waste？
Sometimes I really don't want to get out of bed. That's not good.
The morning TV drama is at such a good part right now. I can't wait to see what happens...
This morning, you woke me up in my dream. Thank you... Just kidding.
I was leisurely reading the newspaper and suddenly it was time to leave, which surprised me. I have to be careful.
I couldn't tie the scarf on my uniform right, it was such a pain. Days like that happen sometimes.
Breakfast？ I had freshly baked bread, you know？ So fluffy and chewy and delicious▼
Today, I tried doing nothing and just relaxing. But I couldn't settle down, so I ended up cleaning. Hehe.
When I went shopping, there were some lovely clothes... hey, will you look at them with me next time？
I played the piano at my own pace... it felt so nice. I really do love the piano.
Today I made bread with Mama. Pow！ We kneaded it.
The school store at lunch break is really something... I wonder what happens when a new item comes out.
I traded bento with my friends, and theirs was so good. They praised mine too.
Some kind of construction started nearby. It's distracting and I can't concentrate, so I hope it ends soon...
I accidentally yawned in the hallway and a friend saw me... how embarrassing...
When the weather's nice, don't you want to sneak out and play？ Just kidding.
...I just ate some snacks with friends from class. Keep it a secret, okay？
In a corner of the garden, a flower I'd never seen before bloomed. I wonder if a bird carried the seed.
A neighbor shared some freshly picked vegetables with us. I can't wait to cook them.
When I went to the cake shop, my favorite cake was sold out. Next time I have to go earlier.
I went for a walk with the dogs I played with before♪ I want to go again.
I'm hungry. ...Don't tempt me, okay？ I'll give in.
The hallways in the evening have a nice feel, don't they？ At night, they're a little scary, though.
The vending machine at the school store seems to be broken. They're calling it a "shady vending machine." ...What does that mean？
They repainted the school gate, didn't they？ I have to be careful not to touch it.
At break, my friends tried all kinds of hairstyles on me. I learned a lot♪
I watched the sunset on the roof with my friends. It was so beautiful... I wish I could have watched it with you.
Today, I tried making something a little fancy. ...Want a taste？
Papa made dinner tonight. Yes, it was delicious. Mama was all smiles too.
I thought I'd lie down for just a second, and then it was this late. What if I can't sleep later...
I thought about staying up late, but... I'll stop after all.
I made my test summary notes, so I thought I'd relax for the rest of the day. Want to join me？
Someone's dog was howling along with a police siren. That kind of thing is so cute.
I tried a new bath salt, and it smelled so nice and felt so good. I recommend it, you know？
When I was stretching in the living room, Papa and Mama started doing it with me, you know？ Hehe, it was fun.
When I was in the bath, the lights suddenly went out and it scared me. Why would they go out right then...
Preview, review, ready for tomorrow. Perfect. Just kidding. Hehe！
I was reading my favorite author's new book... ...I might be sleepy.
I was chatting with Mama and suddenly it was this late. Mama was yawning too.
Mm... okay. I'm going to bed, okay？ Don't stay up too late either, okay？
I took a long nap, and now I can't sleep. Would hot milk help me sleep？
I woke up thirsty and went to the living room, and Papa was working... I wish he wouldn't push himself...
I was solving a tough math problem. ...Going to sleep without knowing the answer is frustrating, right？
I drank some strong tea and now I'm wide awake... what if I get sleepy in class？
Papa and Mama were asleep, so I secretly watched TV... at this hour, it's all shopping channels, huh？
Just now there was a loud crash outside and I jumped out of bed. I hope it wasn't an accident...
If I stayed up like this until morning, what would happen to me... I kind of want to try.
You know, do you like studying？
You know, do you like moving your body？
You know, are you good at drawing？
You know, are you interested in fashion？
You know, are you the type to clean properly？
You know, do you cook too？
You know, you're not letting your laundry pile up, are you？
You know, do you like going out to have fun？
You know, do you like relaxing indoors？
You know, do you like taking it easy in the park？
You know, are you interested in visiting old buildings？
You know, do you like movies？
You know, do you like moving your body？
You know, do you like eating？
You know, do you like shopping？
You know, are you interested in photography？ Ah, taking them, I mean.
You know, do you like the solemn atmosphere of a church？
You know, do you go to concerts？
You know, do you like singing？
You know, do you play games？
You know, do you usually listen to music？
You know, do you like anime？
You know, do you like amusement park dates？
You know, are you good at swimming？
You know, do you like stargazing？
You know, do you like flowers and plants？
You know, when there's an event, do you usually go see it？
You know, do you like shopping？
You know, do you like going to the beach？
...You know, girls in swimsuits... are you interested？
You know, do you like fish？
You know, would you like to try mountain climbing？
You know, do you like animals？
You know, do you like playing outdoors in nature？
You know, baths feel so nice, right？
You know, do you do anything before bed？
You know, recommend me a romance movie？
You know, out of the dishes I've made, do you have a favorite？
You know, for breakfast, do you want Western？ Or Japanese？
You know, would you like to hear me play the piano？
You know, is there a country or place you'd like to go together？
You know, of all the dates we've been on, where was your favorite place？
You know, fairy-tale romances are lovely, aren't they？
You know, date days always make your heart race, right？
You know, your first love... was it me, I wonder.
You know, should I cuddle up closer to you？
You know, what do you think about living with me...？
You know, our anniversary. Do you remember it properly？
Um. Well... do you like girls who are forward？ ...In all sorts of ways.
I knew it？ Yes, I had a feeling.
Yes, I just wanted to ask. For no reason.
I learned one more thing about you. Hehe.
Because I wanted to know about you...
So that's how it is... hmm...
Ah... did I ask that before？ Sorry.
Sorry, asking the same thing over and over. I wondered how it is now.
Right, I've asked a few times... but please. Tell me？
Hey, do boys, um... prefer them bigger...？
I see... but how big counts as big... ah, no, never mind！
Average is fine, right？ Yes. Isn't it？
...I knew it... maybe I should go on a diet...
Really？ I'm glad... I'm glad I asked, thank you.
Lately I feel like I've gotten a little plumper, is that okay？
Good. I've been eating a lot lately, so I was worried.
I see... I haven't gained weight, though. What should I do？
Hey, will you tell me what dishes you like？
What do you think of dishes that don't fit any category？
I'm glad. Hm？ Look forward to it.
I see？ ...But I'll practice anyway. Yes.
Got it. I'll do my best.
I just want to feed the person I love something delicious, you know？
Hmm... I'll make sure I don't slack on practice.
The other day I got a new recipe. When I make it, will you eat it？
I found another delicious-looking recipe. I can't wait to make it♪
Lately I'm really into Western food. I've even been coming up with original menus.
Lately I'm into Chinese food. I'm even getting particular about seasonings... hehe, curious？
Lately I'm into Japanese food. There's still so much I don't know, it's really fun.
When someone asks my specialty, I want to be able to say I'm good at every genre.
Lately I've gotten into making sweets again. ...I have to be careful not to gain weight.
Hey, have you... decided what we're doing for our next date？
I see. Then I'll look forward to it？
Then let's think about it together. Where would be good？
Going somewhere lively might be nice once in a while？
Mm... maybe I'd like to go somewhere we've never been.
We've been to almost every date spot, haven't we？
How about the place we had the most fun before？
Somewhere with delicious restaurants nearby！ Just kidding.
Then shall we go somewhere fun indoors？
Oh, how about somewhere fun outdoors？
Hmm... how about this？ Going to see an event or exhibition.
Hey, how about shopping for our next date？
Hey, how about somewhere we can move around for our next date？
Hey, shall we go somewhere relaxing for our next date？
Hey, maybe somewhere with lots to play for our next date？
You'll go with my idea？ Thank you.
Hehe, it's decided！ I'll be looking forward to it▼
Ah, that's mean. Just kidding. Then I'll leave it to you？
Thinking about it together like this is fun, isn't it？
Okay, I'll look forward to it. Just kidding.
Going after school might be nice once in a while？
We can't forget to check out delicious places. Right？
Let's make it a wonderful date？
I wish the day would come already. Hehe！
I have to be careful not to get home late again. Right？
...Hey. Do you like... being kissed by your girlfriend？
Hmm？ Then maybe I won't hold back？ Just kidding.
I see. It's embarrassing, but... mm. Got it.
I see. Then maybe I'll leave it to you？ Just kidding.
...I see. ...Ah, no. It's nothing. Don't mind me？
Do boys, um... like kissing pushily？
I see. Huh... um, it's not that I dislike it, but... geez, don't look at me so much.
Really？ ...Once in a while is fine, I think？ Just kidding.
It makes me feel cherished, I'm happy. Thank you...
Hey, where do you like touching？
Me too... when you touch me, I feel at ease.
...That's embarrassing. I'm the one who asked, though...
Hehe, like my upper arms？ Just kidding.
I like it too. Your hands are so warm.
...Yes. Being held tight... makes you happy, right？
Hey, do you like feeding each other, saying "ahh"？
I like it too. It's a little embarrassing, though...
Really？ It was a dream of mine too.
If it's just the two of us, I might be bold about it. ...Just kidding.
Really？ For me... a little is fine.
...I see. Mm... it's a bit embarrassing with people watching, right？
I don't mind it that much, you know？ Being fed.
Hey, are you getting enough sleep lately？
Are you eating three meals a day？
You're not snacking too much, are you？
Hey, are you keeping warm when you sleep？
Do you turn off the air conditioner when you sleep？
Hey, tell me？ As your girlfriend, I want to know.
Geez... just don't forget that I worry about you, okay？
So thorough？ I might lose to you.
You're doing it right. As expected.
I see... that worries me a little？ Let's be careful.
Let's be a little better about it？ Okay？
Huh... really？ Little by little is fine, but let's improve？ Okay？
That's no good... hey, let's do better？ Please...
Let's get proper sleep？ I can't say at the same time as me, though. Okay？
Let's start with some light exercise little by little？ I'll cheer you on！
You should eat properly, you know？ Hey, let's eat together？
Only snacking isn't good, you know？ I'll be careful too. Okay？
Geez... you'll catch a cold, you know？ Keep warm when you sleep.
Leaving it on is a no, absolutely. Turn it off when you sleep？ Um... for my sake too.
The place we went today was fun, wasn't it？
Hey, the place we went the other day was fun, wasn't it？
We played all kinds of games, didn't we？ Let's play together again？
Photo prints make great keepsakes, so they make me happy.
Medal games are so exciting. I want to play again.
The jackpot was amazing！ I hope we see it again.
We got scratch cards, didn't we？ Hey, let's go again？
What？ All of a sudden. ...That's embarrassing.
Geez, so flippant. ...I'm not going to say "me too"！
It doesn't sound like you mean it...
I don't want you to say it so lightly...
...I love you. More than anyone in the world, you know？
I like you. Ah, sorry. ...I love you.
I wouldn't be with someone I didn't like. Just kidding.
...I love you, you know？ But... I wish you'd think about me a little more.
Why would you say that now...
Mm. If it's just a little...
I don't know what you're thinking...
Geez. You always say things like that.
Could it be we're... a silly lovey-dovey couple？
Only a boyfriend and girlfriend could have a talk like this, right？
Hehe. Mm, I'm just having fun.
Geez, I feel like I'll be stuck smiling forever.
...Don't look so much. My face will get even redder...
▲主人公＊▲. ...I just felt like saying your name.
Geez, no fair. I'm going to ask too.
Hey, I want to ask too？
Now it's my turn to ask, okay？
▲新主人公▲. ...How would you feel if I called you that？
Really？ Then maybe I'll try calling you that？
▲新主人公▲. ...Sorry, it's too embarrassing after all. Let me try another time？
I see. Then I won't？ But it felt kind of fresh. Hehe！
You know？ There's something I want to talk about... lend me your ear？
Come closer？ I don't want anyone to hear...
Hey, can you hear me？ If you can, say "I can hear you"？
Then I'll say it... you know？
I can't think about anything but you...
The end of the year is almost here. A countdown together... Just kidding.
The New Year holidays were fun. This year is going to be a wonderful one.
Valentine's Day is almost here. My research is airtight.
Thank you for being so happy about Valentine's. It made it all worth it.
White Day is almost here. Don't go to too much trouble, okay？
Thank you for White Day. Actually, I was really... looking forward to it.
April Fool's Day is almost here. Lies that make people sad are... a no！
I was just remembering April Fool's Day.
The excursion is almost here. I have to get ready properly.
The excursion was fun. I wish we had one every month.
The chorus contest is almost here. I wonder if it'll go well.
The chorus contest made a nice memory. ...We worked hard.
Tanabata is almost here. I have to think of a wish.
Tanabata was fun. You have to enjoy these events properly.
The Towano Festival is almost here. I wonder how lively it'll be this year...
The Towano Festival was fun. I really let loose♪
Sports day is almost here. Time for special training！ Just kidding.
Sports day was fun. It gives you a different sense of accomplishment than club does.
Halloween is almost here. Maybe I'll make a jack-o'-lantern.
Halloween was fun. A little embarrassing, though.
The school festival is almost here. I really want this year's festival to be a wonderful memory.
The school festival was fun. I'm glad we worked so hard.
Christmas is almost here... I really want to be with you...
Thank you for the Christmas memories. Manaka is happy.
Your birthday's coming up... is there anything you want？
I wonder if I can get it for you？
I'll do my best. Sorry if I can't.
...I see. Um, can I put that on hold？
My birthday's coming up, right？ There's something I want... hey, try guessing？
Correct？ Birthday wishes from you. Hehe.
The answer is... you know？ A kiss from you. A little more special than usual...
Um, the answer is... special time spent with you. Just kidding.
Hey, how do you want to spend our anniversary？
Me？ Just being together makes me happy, you know？
Um, you know？ I think I'd like something to remember it by.
Hey, tell me your resolutions for this year？
Yes, I'm sure you can do it. I'll cheer you on！
My resolution？ It's to be with you... no, maybe I'll keep it a secret？ Hehe.
My resolution is for the two of us to push each other to be better, I guess？ ...There's a lot, right？
This month's almost over... hey, what was the most fun thing lately？
For me, going cherry blossom viewing. The blossoms were so pretty...
For me, eating lots and lots of strawberries. Strawberries are so good▼
For me, basking in the sun. The spring breeze and the sunshine felt so nice.
For me, going "ahh" into the electric fan. Hehe, childish？
For me, eating delicious shaved ice, I think. The ice tastes completely different, you know？
For me, the fireworks in the garden. I think sparklers are my favorite...
For me, enjoying all the flavors of autumn▼ I cooked lots too... so satisfying. Hehe.
For me, watching lots of old movies on DVD. It's the autumn of art, after all. Just kidding.
For me, enjoying the autumn leaves, I guess？ So vivid, so beautiful.
For me, making all kinds of hot pots. Cabbage hot pot with ponzu is the Takane family recommendation▼
For me, when it snowed. I watched it from my room the whole time...
For me, eating ice cream under the kotatsu. And of course, mikan too▼
Hey, do you have time now？ If you're free, let's play？
Hey, are you busy？ I want to play... Just kidding.
If you're free, would you keep me company？ Just kidding.
Hey, was that fun？ Want to play again？
You always say things like that. ...Just this once, okay？
Hey, which one should we play？
Want to play Yie Ar Kung-Fu？
Then that one. I won't lose, okay？
You don't want to？ I see... then next time.
Then let's play a game called Just Count？ When you think 30 seconds have passed, say "Now！" I'll keep time.
Okay, here we go？ Ready... start！
Too bad. 30 seconds haven't passed yet.
Ah, so close！ Just a little more.
Too bad... a little late. You have to say "Now," okay？
Lately... you haven't been texting me much, have you？
You always text me so often... thank you. I'm happy.
Lately we haven't been able to go out together, and I'm lonely... once you're less busy, take me on a date？
You always take me to all sorts of places... thank you. Let's keep it up, okay？
Lately you haven't been calling me out much. Even just hearing your voice would make me happy, though.
